newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps slip, fuel down $2, CFDs drift 6 ct.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps slip, fuel down $2, CFDs drift 6 ct.

text.p: European oil swaps slipped lower on Wednesday, dragged lower by faltering oil futures.
Brent crude CFDs were unchanged for the balance of this week at 39 cents under June but next week's dates slipped six cents to 43 cents under. The following two weeks fell a similar amount.

Gasoline swaps slipped 25 cents after trading at $197.25 for May during the morning. Physical traded at $197 for any May and $193.25 for April. June swaps talked some $3.50 a tonne below May, with July a further $3.50 below June.

Heavy fuel eased $2 a tonne to talk around $82 for May barges after peaking at $85.50 on Tuesday. June was 50 cents higher but dealers said the thin physical market had dampened trade. Low sulphur was valued around $87.50 for May.

Jet premiums were flat with May bid at $24.50 a tonne above the IPE after trading at that level last Thursday. The third and fourth quarters were little changed at $27.50 and $31.50 above the screen respectively.
